description: This file defines the LegendEntryRenderer class responsible for rendering legend entries in chart visualizations, including drawing markers, lines, and associated text, based on chart type and legend entry information.

classes.name: LegendEntryRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing legend entries in charts, handling layout calculations and rendering of markers, lines, and labels.

methods.name: LegendEntryRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with parameters.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout dimensions and sizes for the legend entry based on content and chart type.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the legend entry, including marker, line (for line charts), and text.
